How to use

To add a background, click on the image icon.
To add images, click on the easel icon.
To add textboxes, click on the speech bubble icon.
To add music, click on the note icon.
To add clickable buttons, click on the arrow icon.
To download the game, click on the download icon.
To move images, boxes, and more, press M.
To rotate, press R.
To scale, press S.
To link images to textboxes, press L while both are selected.
